thread:
Carla (Support): Escalating P1 for trial account acerohealth.dev — embedding requests failing intermittently across 3 tenant namespaces; onboarding flows blocked. Error spike started ~15m ago. Can CS take comms and owner mapping?
Ben (CS): On it. Lead the bridge if SRE can stand up a mitigation. Also flagging renewal risk: they're mid-trial and have two demos scheduled. We should offer a short reprieve/credit proactively.
Carla (Support): Quick context: /v1/embeddings requests returning 502s and intermittent 401s. Restarted inference-gateway and flushed prefix cache; failures persisted. Sample log: `ERROR inference-gateway: upstream returned 502 for model redwood-embed-5-large trace=3a9d`
OpsBot: [alert] customer=acerohealth.dev incidents=[INC-20245] severity=high affected_tenants=3
Iris (SRE): Suspect embed pool saturation combined with a token rotation race for two tenant namespaces. Plan: scale standby pool and attempt targeted routing. Cmds: `kubectl scale deployment/embed-pool-standby --replicas=3` then `rwctl route update --tenant acerohealth --model standby-embed-1 --weight 1.0`
Carla (Support): We attempted fallback to quantized-embed-4 but gateway rejected with model_compat error. Also seeing `{"error":"token_mismatch","code":401}` on two tenants.
Ben (CS): Ok plan: 1) Iris to run standby scale + routing, 2) Carla to verify tenant tokens and re-issue if needed, 3) CS to send a short proactive note and set a 15-min bridge. Omar please approve goodwill trial credit.
Omar (Acct Exec): Approve a goodwill credit + 7-day trial extension given they have scheduled demos. We'll include that in the follow-up.
Iris (SRE): Standby pool scaled, routing applied for subset. Observed one tenant recover to 95% success. Two tenants still returning 401 token_mismatch. Investigating token rotation logs.
Carla (Support): Token team found a stale key cached by the gateway for two tenant namespaces. Workaround: reissue API tokens via admin console and invalidate old tokens. Test curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["test"]}'` returns 200. I'll run re-issue for affected tenants and confirm.
Ben (CS): Draft proactive note (short & clear):
"Hi <CustomerName>, we detected degraded embedding behavior during your trial causing intermittent failures. We've applied an interim routing fix and are reissuing API keys for affected tenants. Expected full recovery within 60 minutes. We're scheduling a short call to walk through root cause and will credit/extend your trial for the disruption. — Ben, CS"
Carla (Support): +1. Also capture customer feedback post-incident: ask them if the trial timeline needs adjustment and whether they'd like a technical walkthrough. I can add a one-click feedback link in the follow-up.
OpsBot: INC-20245 attached to thread.
Iris (SRE): Confirmed reissue fixed auth for tenant-2; tenant-3 still failing intermittently (edge case cache on edge-proxy). Adding engineering oncall if not resolved in 20m.
Ben (CS): Owners: support/Carla (token reissue + remediation), SRE/Iris (infra + routing), CS/Ben & Omar (comms + credits + demo reschedule), Eng-runtime oncall (if not stable in 20m). Reconvene in 30m to confirm stability. Capture feedback: include short survey and offer technical deep-dive if they opt in.
Carla (Support): Running final checks now. Will update thread once all tenants show >95% success. If not, escalate to eng-runtime.
Ben (CS): I'll send the initial customer note now and share bridge link.
